task: This is a synthetic newspaper-writing exercise using fictional reporting notes. Use only the supplied reporting notes. Write from the reporting snapshot as of August 31, 2026. Write a headline and a 450–650-word AP-style newspaper explainer answering why Bellwether County can report more jobs and a higher unemployment rate at the same time.

facts.text: Bellwether County's August 2026 economic bulletin reports 25,600 payroll jobs in July, up from 25,000 in July 2025.
The payroll count measures positions at workplaces in the county, including positions held by people who commute from elsewhere.
A separate resident labor-force estimate puts July 2026 employment at 19,740 people and unemployment at 1,260.
Those resident figures total a labor force of 21,000, with an unemployment rate of 6%.
The July 2025 resident estimate was 19,000 employed and 1,000 unemployed, a labor force of 20,000 and a 5% unemployment rate.
Resident employment therefore rose by 740 while the number seeking work without a job rose by 260.
The labor force grew by 1,000; the unemployment rate rose by one percentage point, not one percent of its previous value.
The bulletin counts a resident as unemployed only when the person has no job, is available and is actively seeking work under its stated survey definition.
Students, retirees and caregivers not looking for work are outside that definition, rather than automatically unemployed.
Payroll positions and employed residents cannot be subtracted to count commuters because they also differ in coverage of self-employment and multiple jobs.
The bulletin compares the same month in consecutive years and labels the figures as not seasonally adjusted.
County analyst Omi Drel said later employer returns may revise the payroll estimate.
Drel said, "One count starts at the workplace. The other starts with the person who lives here."
Parcel sorter Nessa Holt returned to job seeking in June after spending a year caring for a relative.
Holt has applied for daytime work but says several local vacancies require overnight availability she does not have.
Holt said, "A vacancy can be close to home and still be a shift I cannot take."
A county employer survey lists transport scheduling and machine maintenance among hard-to-fill roles but does not match vacancies to individual job seekers.
The bulletin does not determine how much labor-force growth came from migration, new graduates or people returning to work.
Bellwether has published separate workplace and resident tables since 2012.
The figures do not establish that every industry expanded or that people already employed received higher wages.

forbidden_additions: The two series count the same population or reveal an exact commuter total
A proven single cause of labor-force growth or a wage increase for all workers
preserve: If quoted: One count starts at the workplace. The other starts with the person who lives here.
If quoted: A vacancy can be close to home and still be a shift I cannot take.
A larger employed population can coexist with faster growth in the labor force.
